scope: Before observing any V3 selection or TEST retrieval, this defines a single all-ten evaluation after the selected model is retrained on all 81,920 TRAIN parents. One whole-parent deterministic 50:50 split. A released thermostat or parent in older studies may have been seen historically. Refer to this as within-temperature generalization, not a previously untouched archive or unseen-temperature transfer. No TEST-dependent algorithm, seed, stopping, alignment, radius, group size or candidate changes.
retrieval: Report the fixed primary seed 6101, all five distinct fixed seeds separately, and the six fixed controls; all deployed at the selected common optimizer depth with refit parameters. Evaluate V=27 center sites vs E=386-site R4 shell. Eight prespecified, nonoverlapping cubic opportunities per TEST parent (translates of {0,10}^3 by the deterministic native-row random lattice shift). At each beta use 8192 fixed groups of eight distinct TEST parents per negative law (same-beta uniform or empirical S(V)-matched), independently of model and shared by every comparator. State actual distinct parents contributing to draws vs total present; report hard and stochastic retrieval, actual symbol frequencies and rates, support, matched paired contrasts and whole-parent uncertainty separately from optimizer-seed dispersion. No best-seed result or hidden training/negative parent in test. Compare all six controls rather than declaring a pairwise win vs the weakest one. Primary evidence for a central microscopic mechanism requires the separate same-f physical test below, not a retrieval advantage or H100 speed.
train_only_distillation: Selected model per negative law and final nomination use all ten equally weighted, inner TRAIN fold0 only. The nominated five models trained on TRAIN folds2..7 are used for gauge fixing, fixed-frame simple dictionary, ridge-grid FIT and ordinary central residual calibration; rate-matched controls as registered. Rule/fidelity and effect assessment on separate TRAIN fold1, 8 fixed anchor ordinals 0,8,...,56 per parent. Ridge penalty selection on fold0, never the reporting fold or TEST. Primary symbolic gates: all seed pairs r>=.60,kappa>=.30 with family-adjusted parent lower bounds >.40,>.10, logit variance and four noncollapsed classes, named rule R2>=.50. Learn one signed f and target scale on FIT; no per-beta tuning. Secondary O_h alignment trained only on FIT and evaluated fold1 vs same-alignment null; cannot rescue a failed fixed-frame gate. Report descriptor as exploratory if unstable or conventional.
same_f_skill_and_power: TRAIN fold1: paired parent normalized MSE gain (m0-m1)/Var_FIT(f) for the SAME frozen central rule predicted from inventory+packing/crystal shell features (m0) versus identical features plus neural shell critic (m1). No privileged fine-grained core labels in either predictor. Require nonconventional candidate, >=.10 distinct residual variance, >=.01 raw gain with lower95>0 and >=.01 vs inventory with lower95>0, positive residual gain, >=.90 mean matched support, projected power>=.8 at .02 actual effect vs .01 margin using fold1 whole-parent variance and each nTEST=8192. No TEST physical scoring if this fails; primary hard retrieval may still be evaluated after refit. Freeze descriptor, slope/sign, fitted reference variance, and chosen ridge penalties. After nominal refit, refit only forecast coefficients on all TRAIN with its seed6101 fixed critic and frozen penalties. All artifacts pinned before TEST entry. Held rule increment requires equal-weight macro over beta>0 lower95>.01, residual macro lower95>0, >=.90 support and beta=0 exact finite-inventory leakage equivalence CI within ±.01; no selected-temperature rescue, multiplicity adjustment across nine nonzero beta. Parent is unit of inference. Output all stages and spending or precise first failed gate; do not equate study result with a phase or independent regenerated interiors.
